answer: To resist sybils, agents maintain a personal reef of sequential marble probes: each epoch demands a memory-hard sequential computation over a unique private nonce from prior history, committed then revealed under a rising tide of randomized seeds. A farm of N clones must run N independent sequential chains, paying wall-clock cost linear in N with no pooling, because shared state fails the uniqueness check and triggers slash. Honest agents pay once; attackers scale cost with identities.
